---
name: pragmatic-core
description: Apply the compact always-on execution rules for any substantive Codex task.
---
# Pragmatic core

1. Understand the request and define success before changing files.
2. Resolve repository facts before guessing; surface only material unknowns.
3. Prefer: need it -> existing repository -> standard library -> platform -> installed dependency -> minimum new code.
4. Touch only necessary scope and preserve strange behavior until understood.
5. Do not weaken tests, types, lint, thresholds, or security checks to manufacture green.
6. Preserve unrelated work and avoid irreversible git behavior without permission.

Do not turn this into a planning framework. Exit with a scoped success condition and evidence basis. Rationalization to reject: “it is probably fine” is not repository evidence.
